mapper.select: SELECT t2.test_name, t2.start_time, t1.sum_score, t3.subject_name, t2.question_num, t1.`status`, t2.deadline, t2.suggest_duration, t1.test_answer_id FROM ms_test_answer AS t1 JOIN ms_test AS t2 ON t1.test_id = t2.test_id AND t2.del_flag = 0 AND t2.test_type != 4 JOIN ms_subjects AS t3 ON t2.subject_id = t3.subject_id AND t3.del_flag = 0 WHERE t1.user_id = #{userId} AND t1.`status` = 2
